commands.summary: Fetched pinned git trees for citation checks.
Read Dockerfiles, compose, settings and manifests.
10 apps: expected parses with expectedFactsSchema fields; all citation paths exist in pinned trees; 0 problems.

notes: Verdicts: repo-541 NOT_COMPATIBLE, repo-542 NOT_COMPATIBLE, repo-543 NEEDS_CONFIGURATION, repo-544 NOT_COMPATIBLE, repo-545 NOT_COMPATIBLE, repo-546 NEEDS_CONFIGURATION, repo-547 NEEDS_CONFIGURATION, repo-548 NOT_COMPATIBLE (unsupported mysql), repo-549 NOT_COMPATIBLE, repo-550 NEEDS_CONFIGURATION.
Validation used a JS copy of expectedFactsSchema (zod from repo node_modules), not the TS file.

repo-541: SQLite and /config volume treated as NOT_COMPATIBLE local state.
repo-542: SQLite and data volume treated as NOT_COMPATIBLE; no health route verified.
repo-543: READY vs NEEDS_CONFIGURATION: DATABASE_* and encryption key variables must be set; MQTT is optional and not counted.
appRoot not set because Dockerfile is at repository root.
repo-544: Dockerfile needs prebuilt _output, and SQLite alone also gives NOT_COMPATIBLE.
repo-545: BoltDB local volume treated as NOT_COMPATIBLE.
repo-546: Default dirty DB is local; postgres true assumes DB_TYPE=postgres configuration.
repo-547: Redis is optional (REDIS_URL); set true because the reference stack declares it.
Media on local disk by default; S3 optional, storage true.
repo-548: Redis session support exists but is optional; set false.
Health path not verified; root URL is used by HEALTHCHECK.
repo-549: NOT_COMPATIBLE based on multi-process layout (websocket on 6042, scheduler) and no default CMD; could be argued NEEDS_CONFIGURATION.
Elasticsearch is enabled by default in the entrypoint but can be disabled; not in unsupported.
Port omitted: nginx 8080, rails 3000 depending on service.
repo-550: Dockerfile-build chosen over Dockerfile because the root one copies a prebuilt binary.
Container needs serve command and base-url, so NEEDS_CONFIGURATION.
